verses.original: וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִיא֩ יַעֲמֹ֨ד מִֽיכָאֵ֜ל הַשַּׂ֣ר הַגָּד֗וֹל הָעֹמֵד֮ עַל־ בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּךָ֒ וְהָיְתָה֙ עֵ֣ת צָרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ נִהְיְתָה֙ מִֽהְי֣וֹת גּ֔וֹי עַ֖ד הָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא וּבָעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ יִמָּלֵ֣ט עַמְּךָ֔ כָּל־ הַנִּמְצָ֖א כָּת֥וּב בַּסֵּֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·‘êṯ ha·hî ya·‘ă·mōḏ mî·ḵā·’êl haś·śar hag·gā·ḏō·wl hā·‘ō·mêḏ ‘al- bə·nê ‘am·me·ḵā wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ‘êṯ ṣā·rāh ’ă·šer lō- nih·yə·ṯāh mih·yō·wṯ gō·w ‘aḏ hā·‘êṯ ha·hî ū·ḇā·‘êṯ ha·hî yim·mā·lêṭ ‘am·mə·ḵā kāl- han·nim·ṣā kā·ṯūḇ bas·sê·p̄er
verses.literal: At that time Michael the great prince who stands watch over your people . . . will rise up There will be a time of distress the likes of which will not have occurred from the beginning of nations until that time But at that time your people everyone whose name is found written in the book will be delivered

verses.original: וְרַבִּ֕ים מִיְּשֵׁנֵ֥י אַדְמַת־ עָפָ֖ר יָקִ֑יצוּ אֵ֚לֶּה לְחַיֵּ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם וְאֵ֥לֶּה לַחֲרָפ֖וֹת לְדִרְא֥וֹן עוֹלָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·rab·bîm mî·yə·šê·nê ’aḏ·maṯ- ‘ā·p̄ār yā·qî·ṣū ’êl·leh lə·ḥay·yê ‘ō·w·lām wə·’êl·leh la·ḥă·rā·p̄ō·wṯ lə·ḏir·’ō·wn ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: And many who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake some to everlasting life but others to shame and everlasting contempt

verses.original: וְהַ֨מַּשְׂכִּלִ֔ים יַזְהִ֖רוּ כְּזֹ֣הַר הָרָקִ֑יעַ וּמַצְדִּיקֵי֙ הָֽרַבִּ֔ים כַּכּוֹכָבִ֖ים לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·maś·ki·lîm yaz·hi·rū kə·zō·har hā·rā·qî·a‘ ū·maṣ·dî·qê hā·rab·bîm kak·kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm lə·‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: Then the wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens and those who lead many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever and ever

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה דָֽנִיֵּ֗אל סְתֹ֧ם הַדְּבָרִ֛ים וַחֲתֹ֥ם הַסֵּ֖פֶר עַד־ עֵ֣ת קֵ֑ץ יְשֹׁטְט֥וּ רַבִּ֖ים וְתִרְבֶּ֥ה הַדָּֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḏā·nî·yêl sə·ṯōm had·də·ḇā·rîm wa·ḥă·ṯōm has·sê·p̄er ‘aḏ- ‘êṯ qêṣ yə·šō·ṭə·ṭū rab·bîm wə·ṯir·beh had·dā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: But you Daniel shut up these words and seal the book until the time of the end Many will roam to and fro and knowledge will increase

verses.original: וְרָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֔אל וְהִנֵּ֛ה שְׁנַ֥יִם אֲחֵרִ֖ים עֹמְדִ֑ים אֶחָ֥ד הֵ֙נָּה֙ לִשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְאֹ֔ר וְאֶחָ֥ד הֵ֖נָּה לִשְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’î·ṯî ’ă·nî ḏā·nî·yêl wə·hin·nêh šə·na·yim ’ă·ḥê·rîm ‘ō·mə·ḏîm ’e·ḥāḏ hên·nāh liś·p̄aṯ hay·’ōr wə·’e·ḥāḏ hên·nāh liś·p̄aṯ hay·’ōr
verses.literal: Then I Daniel looked and saw two others standing there one on this bank of the river and one on the opposite bank . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לָאִישׁ֙ לְב֣וּשׁ הַבַּדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִמַּ֖עַל לְמֵימֵ֣י הַיְאֹ֑ר עַד־ מָתַ֖י קֵ֥ץ הַפְּלָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·’îš lə·ḇūš hab·bad·dîm ’ă·šer mim·ma·‘al lə·mê·mê hay·’ōr ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay qêṣ hap·pə·lā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: One of them said to the man dressed in linen who was above the waters of the river How long until the fulfillment of these wonders

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֞ע אֶת־ הָאִ֣ישׁ׀ לְב֣וּשׁ הַבַּדִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִמַּעַל֮ לְמֵימֵ֣י הַיְאֹר֒ וַיָּ֨רֶם יְמִינ֤וֹ וּשְׂמֹאלוֹ֙ אֶל־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע בְּחֵ֣י הָעוֹלָ֑ם כִּי֩ לְמוֹעֵ֨ד מֽוֹעֲדִ֜ים וָחֵ֗צִי וּכְכַלּ֛וֹת נַפֵּ֥ץ יַד־ עַם־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ תִּכְלֶ֥ינָה כָל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·ma‘ ’eṯ- hā·’îš lə·ḇūš hab·bad·dîm ’ă·šer mim·ma·‘al lə·mê·mê hay·’ōr way·yā·rem yə·mî·nōw ū·śə·mō·lōw ’el- haš·šā·ma·yim way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ bə·ḥê hā·‘ō·w·lām kî lə·mō·w·‘êḏ mō·w·‘ă·ḏîm wā·ḥê·ṣî ū·ḵə·ḵal·lō·wṯ nap·pêṣ yaḏ- ‘am- qō·ḏeš tiḵ·le·nāh ḵāl ’êl·leh
verses.literal: And the man dressed in linen who was above the waters of the river raised his right hand and his left hand toward heaven and I heard him swear by Him who lives forever saying It will be for a time and times and half a time When the power of the holy people has finally been shattered all these things will be completed

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אָבִ֑ין וָאֹ֣מְרָ֔ה אֲדֹנִ֕י מָ֥ה אַחֲרִ֖ית אֵֽלֶּה׃פ
verses.literal: I heard but I did not understand So I asked My lord what will be the outcome of these things

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֵ֣ךְ דָּנִיֵּ֑אל כִּֽי־ סְתֻמִ֧ים וַחֲתֻמִ֛ים הַדְּבָרִ֖ים עַד־ עֵ֥ת קֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lêḵ dā·nî·yêl kî- sə·ṯu·mîm wa·ḥă·ṯu·mîm had·də·ḇā·rîm ‘aḏ- ‘êṯ qêṣ
verses.literal: Go on your way Daniel he replied for the words are closed up and sealed until the time of the end

verses.original: יִ֠תְבָּֽרֲרוּ וְיִֽתְלַבְּנ֤וּ וְיִצָּֽרְפוּ֙ רַבִּ֔ים וְהִרְשִׁ֣יעוּ רְשָׁעִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֖ינוּ כָּל־ רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְהַמַּשְׂכִּלִ֖ים יָבִֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yiṯ·bā·ră·rū wə·yiṯ·lab·bə·nū wə·yiṣ·ṣā·rə·p̄ū rab·bîm wə·hir·šî·‘ū rə·šā·‘îm wə·lō yā·ḇî·nū kāl- rə·šā·‘îm wə·ham·maś·ki·lîm yā·ḇî·nū
verses.literal: Many will be purified made spotless and refined but the wicked will continue to act wickedly None . . . of the wicked will understand but the wise will understand

verses.original: וּמֵעֵת֙ הוּסַ֣ר הַתָּמִ֔יד וְלָתֵ֖ת שִׁקּ֣וּץ שֹׁמֵ֑ם יָמִ֕ים אֶ֖לֶף מָאתַ֥יִם וְתִשְׁעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·‘êṯ hū·sar hat·tā·mîḏ wə·lā·ṯêṯ šiq·qūṣ šō·mêm yā·mîm ’e·lep̄ mā·ṯa·yim wə·ṯiš·‘îm
verses.literal: And from the time the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination of desolation set up there will be 1,290 . . . . . . days

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֥י הַֽמְחַכֶּ֖ה וְיַגִּ֑יעַ לְיָמִ֕ים אֶ֕לֶף שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê ham·ḥak·keh wə·yag·gî·a‘ lə·yā·mîm ’e·lep̄ šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ šə·lō·šîm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh
verses.literal: Blessed is he who waits and reaches the end of the 1,335 . . . . . . . . . . . . days

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֖ה לֵ֣ךְ לַקֵּ֑ץ וְתָנ֛וּחַ וְתַעֲמֹ֥ד לְגֹרָלְךָ֖ לְקֵ֥ץ הַיָּמִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh lêḵ laq·qêṣ wə·ṯā·nū·aḥ wə·ṯa·‘ă·mōḏ lə·ḡō·rā·lə·ḵā lə·qêṣ hay·yā·mîn
verses.literal: But as for you go on your way until the end You will rest and then you will arise to your inheritance at the end of the days
